description: Everything known about one vulnerability, as an OpenVuln record (a valid OSV record). Give `id`: a CVE (CVE-2026-12537), GHSA, OSV, PYSEC, GO, RUSTSEC, MAL (malicious package) or NDB (nichedb.dev write-up) id. Answers OSV fields (`aliases`, `summary`, `details`, `affected` with version ranges, `severity` vectors, `references`) and `database_specific.openvuln`: `label` (critical/high/medium/low), `fix` (`status` fixed/partial/mitigated/unfixed/unknown, first fixed `versions`, `workaround`), `exploitation` (`status` exploited-ransomware/exploited/poc-public/none-known; `kev` from CISA with added/due/ransomware, null when checked and absent; `epss` score and percentile read live from FIRST; `ai`, AI exploit benchmark tasks such as ExploitGym with `result`, where `unstated` means in the benchmark with no published result), `subject` (package, agent, campaign...), `class`, and `sources` naming where each field came from. Never contains exploit code.

id.description: A vulnerability id, e.g. CVE-2026-12537, GHSA-wpqr-6v78-jr5g, MAL-2026-18177

name: vuln_lookup
